advancements.adorablehamsterpets.husband: The Hamster Life
Welcome to your new life as a rodent enthusiast. I'm only slightly jealous.
The Bait
Transform a humble cucumber into Sliced Cucumber. Rodents go nuts for it.
Pocket Snacks
Whip up some Hamster Food Mix. This is a great opportunity to say 'peckish.' What a fun word.
Seed Money
Acquire Cucumber Seeds. The first step to gaining a tiny, squeaky companion.
A Furry Shadow
Successfully domesticate a wild hamster. May your ankles be ever safe.
Sunflower Hoarder
Gather Sunflower Seeds. They look innocent, but they're part of a larger, fluffier scheme.
A Trustworthy Face
That special Food Mix did the trick! Your hamster now deems you worthy of its cheek-based cargo services.
Shoulder Surfer
Convince a hamster that your shoulder is prime real estate. Hint: Cheese helps.
The Hamster Yeet™
Unleash your shoulder trebuchet. Bonus points for direct Creeper hits. (No hamsters were *terminally harmed in the making of this feature.)
Green Bean Gardener
Procure Green Bean Seeds. These aren't your average beans.
Steamy Greens
Cook up some Green Beans. They smell... suspiciously energizing.
Supercharged Squeaker
Feed your hamster Steamed Green Beans and witness a temporary burst of... ambition.
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.technic: You've crafted the sacred texts of hamster lore. Well done.
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.husband: Petal Pusher
You've subjected your hamster to floral... decor. Um, good job? Should you regret this aesthetic choice, a pair of shears might be key.
Pocket Paramedic
Your hamster, displaying remarkable self-preservation, raided its own cheek stash. Clever, or just really hungry?
Nose for Treasure
Your shoulder-mounted alarm system just detected... something shiny. Or possibly just lint. Good luck.
Impending Doom Squeak
That high-pitched noise wasn't your tinnitus. Your hamster thinks a Creeper fancies you. Run. Or don't. Your funeral.
Chipmunk Aspirations
Those cheeks are at maximum capacity. Your hamster is either preparing for the apocalypse or just really, really likes snacks.
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.recipes: Learned how to craft the Hamster Guide Book.
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.husband: Canine Aspirations?
Your hamster successfully sniffed out diamonds! Wow! This mod is amazing!
Carat Confusion
Witness your hamster's devastation upon realizing that it did not, in fact, find diamonds.
Load-Bearing Human
You have now become structural support for a tower of furry rodents. Pause and take it in.
Luxury Leaf Pile
You've successfully assembled a slightly more organized pile of leaves. It's basically a five-star rodent resort.
Leaf Bender Supreme
A complete portfolio of hamster beds. Your hamster now has better housing options than most villagers. You've peaked.
Home is Where the Leaves Are
You've officially claimed a pile of leaves for your hamster. It's like a tiny, leafy mortgage.
Sweet Dreams 'r Made of Leaves
Your hamster has successfully navigated to its bed and passed out. A truly monumental achievement.
Artisanal Floor Mulch
You've successfully combined leaves, mulch, and some twigs. Your hamster will be thrilled. Or they might eat it. 50/50, really.
Interior Desecrator
You've discovered that hamster bedding doubles as a portable, eco-friendly confetti cannon. Your janitor will not be amused.
High-Tech Allergy Attack
You've automated the process of making a mess. Your commitment to laziness is noted and, frankly, respected.
Australian Feng Shui
You looked at a perfectly functional hamster bed and thought, 'Needs more... inversion.' A bold choice. Questionable, but bold.
Tree Heist
Launch your hamster into an Oak tree. It's not abandonment if they come back with loot.
Return on Investnut
Obtain an Acorn. Represents the absolute pinnacle of hamster foraging technology.
Ecological Menace
Cast responsibility to the wind by over-harvesting a tree until it stops giving acorns.
Industrial Nutcracking
Apply heavy machinery to a small seed. It's violent, efficient, and creates sharp shrapnel. Perfect.
Hardened Salad
Construct armor made of nuts. It completely negates damage by shattering instantly. A brilliant strategy.
Expensive Therapy
Upgrade to Diamond plating. Stops them from stealing your items; cheaper than counseling.
The Immovable Object
Upgrade to Netherite plating. Knockback rules? More like... guidelines, Mrs. Turner.
Squirrel Cosplay
Equip the Acorn Hat. Your hamsters cuteness has increased from infinity to... infinity squared.
MURDERER
You killed a hamster. My only question is... why?
Rodent Reckoning
Defeated by a... hamster. I definitely won't put that on your tombstone.
It Can't Be True!
What do you mean this just a good for nothing weed? It glows at night.
Amateur Zoologist
You've collected 10 unique wild hamsters. The beginnings of a furry army.
The Spice of Life
You've collected 50 unique wild hamsters. Your house is probably starting to smell a bit funny at this point.
Gotta Catch a Fraction of 'Em
You've collected 100 unique wild hamsters. Only a few thousand left to go. No pressure.
Obsession Foreshadowing
You've collected 1,000 unique wild hamsters. It's time to go touch some grass.
Actually Did Catch 'Em All
You tamed every single naturally occurring hamster variant. Impressive, and mildly concerning. But mostly just impressive.
Playing God
You smashed two genetic codes together. The result is adorable, and entirely your fault.
Genetic Blender
You have discovered 100 unique hamster combinations. The family tree is starting to look less like a tree and more like a tumbleweed.
Chromosomal Chaos
You have discovered 500 unique hamster combinations. Who is your name tag supplier? I must know.
The Endless Horde
You have discovered 1,000 unique hamster combinations. You stared into the abyss of furry rodent breeding, and it squeaked back.
The Millionth Squeak

You have discovered one million unique hamster combinations. An absolutely staggering, monumental use of your time. And the best part? You aren't even halfway done. I didn't add any more achievements after this because everyone needs to touch grass at some point.
Seeing Red
You successfully bred a hamster with recessive red eyes. Try not to look directly into its soul, unless you're into that sort of thing.
Moist Tones
Obtain the legendary Cheese Music Disc, and simultaneously avoid asking yourself where that Charged Creeper was storing the disc before you knocked it out of his— oops, almost gave it away.

book.adorablehamsterpets.hamster_guide_b: §6§o Guidebook to the Tiny, Furry Heart§r
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.landin: $(br)So, you want hamsters?$(br2)An admirable, if slightly predictable, goal.$(br2)This guide contains dubious wisdom gleaned from watching small rodents. Use at your own risk.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.the_ha: So you've decided you need more squeaking in your life. <i>Excellent.</>$(br2)This chapter covers the essentials— where to find them, the art of the vegetable bribe, and the finer points of convincing them to stay put.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.regional_: Rumor has it, hamsters adapt. Expect different fur colors for each location:$(br2)<dark_green><b>Icy</>: Blue$(br)<dark_green><b>Magic</>: Lavender$(br)<dark_green><b>Snowy</>: White/Sky$(br)<dark_green><b>Mountainous</>: Gray$(br)<dark_green><b>Dark/Wet</>: Black/Gray$(br)<dark_green><b>Sandy</>: Cream$(br)<dark_green><b>Forested</>: Chocolate$(br)<dark_green><b>Auburn</>: Rust$(br)<dark_green><b>Plains</>: Orange
<light_gray><i>Some hamsters were uncooperative during the shoot.</>

Wild hamster's fur coats are made from <u>{BASE_PALETTES}</> base coats + <u>{WILD_OVERLAYS}</> optional overlays, creating <u>{TOTAL_WILD_VARIANTS}</> distinct variants.$(br2)Most except cave dwellers have White/Cream/Gray-ish overlays.$(br2)Need to see them all together? Try $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands)<dark_green><b>these</>.

$(l:the_hamster_life/breeding)<dark_green><b>Breed</> two wild hamsters together, and the baby might receive an additional 'breeding' overlay or recessive eye color. The total possible combinations quickly escalates to <u>{TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS}</>.$(br2)Curious about the specifics? Check out the $(l:the_hamster_life/breeding)<dark_green><b>Breeding</> chapter.
$(br)<b>Feeling overwhelmed?</>$(br2)Install Jade and look at a hamster.$(br2)The Jade HUD will reveal their genetic data: base coat, overlays, age, health, and recessive red-eye color genes.

Want to see all the hamsters together or spawn AI-disabled 'statue' hamsters for shop displays?$(br2)Check out $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands)<dark_green><b>Spawn Commands</>.$(br2)Statue hamsters can also be tamed to turn them into real hamsters if $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>enabled</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.taming.pa: First, you need bait.$(br2)The good stuff comes from $(l:crops_food/cucumber)<dark_green><b>Cucumbers</>.$(br2)Find $(l:crops_food/cucumber#bush)<dark_green><b>Wild Cucumber Bushes</> in warmer places — plains, savannas, maybe jungle edges.$(br2)<b>Right-click</> 'em for seeds.

Plant those $(l:crops_food/cucumber#crop)<dark_green><b>Cucumber Seeds</> on farmland. Once grown, harvest the $(l:crops_food/cucumber#crop)<dark_green><b>Cucumbers</>.$(br2)Now, the crucial step: craft the cucumber into $(l:crops_food/cucumber#item)<dark_green><b>Sliced Cucumber</>. This is what the little fuzzballs actually I want.

$(br)Right, the actual taming.$(br2)Remember: <b>Sneak</>(<b>$(k:sneak)</>).$(br2)Hold $(l:crops_food/cucumber#item)<dark_green><b>Sliced Cucumber</>.$(br2)Approach slowly. Hope it doesn't notice your desperation.$(br2)Repeat until furry friend acquired.

$(br)<b>Still not working?</>$(br2)Some other mods don't play well, making taming impossible. If you're running into issues, please visit the FAQ channel in $(l:https://discord.gg/w54mk5bqdf)<dark_green><b>'The Cheek Pouch'</> Discord server. Please don't ask for help until you've read everything thoroughly.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.basic_car: They follow.$(br2)Constantly.$(br2)Right-click your tamed hamster to make it <b>Sit/Stay</>.$(br2)It might doze off. If it does, that's on you. If you die from cuteness overload, that's also on you.

$(br)Tired of the constant stalking?$(br2)Craft a $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#hamster_bed)<dark_green><b>Hamster Bed</>.$(br2)It has a faint aroma of stale cheese and forest floor debris— basically hamster crack. They'll hang around the bed instead of nipping at your heels. You're welcome.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.feeding.p: If your hamster has had a disagreement with, well, anything— feed it seeds or basic crops to patch it up.$(br2)For serious healing, craft $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>Hamster Food Mix</>. It is quite irresistible.
If its healthy, the same basic food might trigger... $(l:the_hamster_life/breeding)<dark_green><b>Love Mode</>.$(br2)Find another hamster also in Love Mode.$(br2)Stand back. Nature happens.

Do not feed it the same mundane food twice in a row. It has standards. It will refuse.$(br2)Exceptions: $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>Hamster Food Mix</> (gourmet stuff) and $(l:crops_food/green_beans#item)<dark_green><b>Steamed Green Beans</>.

Those $(l:crops_food/green_beans#item)<dark_green><b>Steamed Green Beans</>? Just smelt some regular Green Beans. They grant Speed, Strength, Absorption & Regen for a bit. Impressive!$(br2)...But there is a cooldown before it works again. Less impressive.
While wild hamsters are restricted by their environments, tamed hamsters suffer no such limitations when bred.$(br2)Offspring can potentially inherit exclusive <b>Breeding Overlays</>, blending the parents' traits into new combinations not       found in the wild.

Both parent hamsters pass their colors to their offspring.$(br2)Similar parents = similar babies. Vastly different parents = less predictable babies.$(br2)Mix <u>{TOTAL_WILD_VARIANTS}</> wild variants to discover <u>{TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS}</> potential outcomes.

Some of the lighter, less colorful (dilute) hamsters can spawn with a recessive red-eye gene that is hidden in the wild. You can coax this out by selectively breeding dilute hamsters.$(br2)Try not to look directly into their souls. Or do. I'm not        your boss.

Babies are born completely feral and entirely disrespectful of your authority (unless you $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>disabled</> this).$(br2)$(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>Tame</> them after birth to brainwash them into loving you.$(br2)Useful if you and your friend want to choose who gets the babies.

You can feed babies standard food to accelerate their growth. They're not nearly as $(l:the_hamster_life/feeding#pickiness)<dark_green><b>picky</> when young.$(br2)Note: even when tamed, they'll still blindly follow their parents until they mature. Peel them away early with $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>{LURE_ITEM}</>.

If enabled in the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</>, your hamsters will eventually hit a breeding limit and refuse to reproduce.$(br2)If you have server OP permissions, you can tweak the limits and reset them with with these helpful $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands#reset_player_breeding)<dark_green><b>commands</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.access: Your hamster lacks a crippling sense of vanity. Let's fix that.$(br2)This section details the latest in rodent runway fashion, from $(l:accessories/pink_petals)<dark_green><b>flower petals</> to $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>acorn hats</>.$(br2)You can even $(l:accessories/custom_accessories)<dark_green><b>suggest your own!</>
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.how_acces: Your hamster possesses a dedicated inventory slot labeled '$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Bling</>'. Yes, that is the technical term. No, I won't change it.$(br2)<b>Right-Click</> your hamster with accessory to equip it. Or, if you prefer micromanagement, open their $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<dark_green><b>inventory</> and place it manually.

$(br)There is also a separate '$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Armor</>' slot. It functions exactly how you'd expect.$(br2)Pro-tip: The base Acorn Armor <i>also</> includes the hat for aesthetics, but if you want to get the Arboreal Affinity perk, you must equip the separate $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>Acorn Hat</> accessory in the Bling slot.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.custom_ac: The current accessory collection is... sparse, but the hamster haberdashery is just getting started!$(br2)I have tons of accessory ideas, due to people being generally awesome.$(br2)Got your own genius idea for the next     accessory

that absolutely <i>needs</> to exist?$(br2)Pop over to the official Discord server: $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/join_the_discord)<gold><b><i>The Cheek Pouch</>.$(br2)And while you're there, come share screenshots of your cute hamsters! (I can't get enough of those).
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.acorn_hat: Shove the <dark_green><b>Acorn Hat</> into the $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Bling</> slot to grant the Arboreal Affinity perk: double $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#intro)<dark_green><b>Tree Heist</> yields.$(br2)Perhaps looking like a nut helps them infiltrate the canopy unnoticed. Or maybe they just work harder when they feel pretty.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.pink_peta: Stumbled upon some <pink><b>Pink Petals</>? Try <b>right-clicking</> your hamster with them. It's called fashion— look it up.$(br2)Click again to change the position; use shears or the $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Bling</> slot to remove them.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.should: Wield $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>Cheese</> near your tamed companion to have them hop on your shoulder. They might do cool things like alert you to nearby <dark_green><b>Creepers</> that have noticed you, or shiny <dark_aqua><b>Diamonds</>.$(br2)Listen for the unique squeaks and sniffs amongst your own panicked breathing.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.the_hamst: For when words fail and you need a furry, surprisingly aerodynamic solution. Aim (don't stare right at a block), press <b>$(k:adorablehamsterpets.throw_hamster)</>.$(br2)Conveniently, it does exactly enough damage to kill a creeper in one blow. Hamster passes out upon impact. Go$(br)   console it.

$(br)Impatient? Feeding reduces the cooldown.$(br2)Is <b>$(k:adorablehamsterpets.throw_hamster)</> not throwing your hamster?$(br2)Did you add this mod to an existing world? Woopsy.$(br2)Go to: <b>Options > Controls > Key Binds</>. Find <gold><b>"Throw Hamster,"</> and set it to <b>G</> (or your preferred key).
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.creeper_p: That panicked squeak? A <b>Creeper</> has targeted YOU. Not just nearby, <red><b><i>"targeting"</>.$(br2)Maybe your hamster is worried its comfy shoulder perch is about to vanish.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.tiny_pros: So, your shoulder-mounted companion just alerted you to nearby $(l:advanced_rodentry/subterranean_shinies)<dark_aqua><b>Diamonds</>? Excellent.$(br2)Now for the fun part. Dismount your tiny prospector. If it was indeed onto something shiny, it might just take matters into its own feet.
$(br)Watch as it attempts to lead you to the alleged riches.$(br2)But be warned: diamonds smell very similar to... well, um gold, which can be confusing for hamsters. Prepare for tiny drama.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.advanc: Your hamster can do more than just look adorable and eat your seeds.$(br2)This section covers the weird stuff. You know, the features that make you question the very fabric of blocky reality. If you thought the $(l:shoulder_hamsters/the_hamster_yeet)<dark_green><b>yeeting</> was strange, you're in for a treat.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.tree_heis: Tree Heist & Armor

To obtain hamster armor, start by $(l:shoulder_hamsters/the_hamster_yeet)<dark_green><b>throwing</> your hamster at some Oak Leaves (or dismount near them) to initiate a <dark_green><b>Tree Heist</>.$(br2)They will vanish into the canopy, rustle around, and occasionally toss out <dark_green><b>Acorns</> until the tree is depleted.
The Loot

The <dark_green><b>Acorns</>? Useless on their own, unless you enjoy composting and choking hazards.$(br2)Process them in a <b>Stonecutter</> to create $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>Acorn Shards</>, used for $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>Armor</> or the stylish $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>Acorn Hat</>.
Hardened Salad
Combine the shards with the hat to create <dark_green><b>Acorn Armor</>.$(br2)Completely blocks incoming attack damage until it runs out of durability.
So just like wolf$(br)   armor, but more$(br)   adorable.
Magical Rodents

Armor made of nuts is decent. Armor made of magic nuts is better.$(br2)Slap it in an Enchanting Table for <b>Unbreaking</> and <b>Fire Protection</>.$(br2)The second one prevents armored hamsters from being roasted in lava.
Book Learning

Use Enchanted Books and Anvils to add <b>Mending</>, <b>Frost Walker</> and <b>Soul Speed</>.$(br2)<light_gray><i>Note: Protection and Feather Falling are pointless and disabled. The armor is already a damage shield, and hamsters don't take fall damage. Don't be greedy.</>
Military Upgrades

Found a <dark_green><b>Hamster Smithing Template</> in a loot chest? Excellent.$(br2)Use a Smithing Table to plate the <dark_green><b>Armor</> with your shinies.$(br2)Each material offers...     <i>unique</> advantages.
Upgrade Perks I

<light_gray><b>Iron:</> Reduces wind resistance, increasing throw velocity.$(br)<gold><b>Gold:</> Grants a permanent Speed boost.$(br)<dark_purple><b>Netherite:</> Turns the hamster into a dense object. Grants Knockback Resistance and significantly increased throw damage.
Upgrade Perks II

<dark_aqua><b>Diamond:</> This is the expensive therapy option.$(br2)Cover hamster in shiny rock; hamster be good.$(br2)A diamond-clad hamster will be so utterly satisfied that it will eagerly fetch things for you instead of running away with$(br)   them.
<light_gray><i>Me and the boys$(br)   preparing for war</>
The Acorn Economy

Trees have memory. Rob the same oak too many times, and it stops giving up the goods.$(br2)It takes about a day for the ecosystem to forgive you.$(br2)Can't wait? Use the reset $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands#reset_tree_heist)<b>command</> or config $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>button</>.
Market Manipulation

Think nature is too stingy? I added a slider in the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</> just for you.$(br2)Crank up the 'Acorn Drop Chance' if you want it to rain nuts (limit: 1 per second).$(br2)Just don't blame me when your inventory overflows.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hamster_b: Beds & Wander Mode

For when 'following you into lava' is no longer a desirable trait.$(br2)Craft some $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#hamster_bedding)<dark_green><b>Hamster Bedding</> and combine it with wood planks to create a five-star rodent hangout, which serves as an anchor for $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#wander_mode)<dark_green><b>Tamed Wander Mode</>.
Behold, a rare sight.
A hamster, <i>not</> actively stalking you.

Here it is: the primary ingredient for the $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#hamster_bed)<dark_green><b>Hamster Bed</>.$(br2)It also doubles as a portable, eco-friendly confetti cannon, but you didn't hear that from me.
You'll need to combine:$(br)1. The finest debris the forest has to offer.$(br)2. Some twigs.$(br2)The result: incredible artisanal floor mulch.
Botanical Vandalism
Can't find a desert to scavenge Dead Bushes?$(br2)Take a pair of <b>Shears</> to any sapling and aggressively trim it until its will to live completely expires.$(br2)Boom. Instant Dead Bush.
Ahh yes. The hamster bed.$(br2)It can be spiritually, emotionally, and digitally bonded to a single hamster.$(br2)The link can also be undone if you fused the bed to the wrong$(br)   hamster.
<b>Right-click</> your tamed hamster with the bed item in hand to link them.$(br2)Now your hamster will blissfully ignore you and roam freely within range of the bed.
Coordinate colors!
Match your base, or clash horribly. Your$(br)   choice.
I'll let you figure out the other 4 recipes.$(br2)You're smart. You got this.$(br2)P.S.- Don't place the beds upside down. <i>Wink.</>
Tamed Wander Mode

Once you've placed the bed <i>(not upside down),</> you're now the proud operator of a tiny, leafy command center:$(br2)• <b>Right-click</> to toggle Wander Mode on/off.$(br2)• <b>$(k:sneak) + Right-click</> to cycle wander distance.

$(br)• Use $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>Cheese</> to lure them to bed for a nap.$(br2)• Use <b>Rotten Flesh</> to make the bed... unappealing, preventing sleep.$(br2)• <b>$(k:sneak) + Rotten Flesh</> to unlink the bed entirely.$(br2)Breaking the bed also disables Wander Mode.$(br2)Duh.
Immortality?

If you or your server moderator enable 'Respawn in Bed' in the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</>, this bed can become a single-use respawn point if charged with <gold><b>{RESURRECTION_TRIBUTE}</>.$(br2)When your hamster meets its inevitable, physics-based demise, it will simply rematerialize here.

$(br)Preserves their inventory, but not self-confidence. Brief therapy may be required.$(br2)<b><i>Note</>: if you're using an external mod that gives your pets super powers, that sort of data may not be preserved since I haven't manually encoded it.
The Night Shift

Hamster stuck or lost while wandering? No problem. Simply go to sleep in your own bed. During the night, they will utilize <i>rodent determination</> to sneak home.$(br2)You'll wake up to find them sound asleep, pretending they didn't just teleport.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.cheek_pou: Inventory... in their face. Feed them $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>Hamster Food Mix</> to earn cheek access. Then <b>Sneak + Right-click</> a tamed hamster for 6 slots of prime real estate.$(br2)If hurt, they can automatically eat the $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>food mix</> from their cheeks if available.

$(br)And no, you can't stuff a Netherite block in there. Your hamster's cheeks, while surprisingly spacious, are not a pocket dimension. They will refuse to store anything too bulky, pointy, or generally illogical.$(br2)Consult the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</> if you wish to re-define what constitutes 'illogical.'

The <dark_green><b>Bling</> and <dark_green><b>Armor</> slots provide manual control over $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>Accessories</> and $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor)<dark_green><b>Armor</>.$(br2)Strictly speaking, they are unnecessary since you can <i>also</> equip items by <b>right-clicking</>, and remove them by brandishing <b>Shears</>.

$(br)But I added them anyway.$(br2)You're welcome.$(br2)Anyway, civilized folks like yourself should <i>probably</> prefer using inventory slots rather than threatening their pets with garden tools.$(br2)Looking at you, John.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.crop_harv: You might think your crops are safe while you're busy mining. You are incorrect.$(br2)If a tamed hamster is wandering around its bed near your farm, it might decide to perform a <i>'quality control'</> inspection and aggressively stuff the harvest into its$(br)   cheeks.

$(br)Hamsters are messy and tend to accidentally re-plant seeds, so your crops won't go extinct instantly.$(br2)You can also raid their $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<dark_green><b>Cheek Pouch</> later to get your crops back.$(br2)Head to the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>config</> to customize crops, timing, and everything else.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.subterran: Those excited sniffs? Your pocket prospector smells <dark_aqua><b>Diamonds!</> Checks a 10-block radius by default.$(br2)It pauses between alerts, so listen carefully before you start digging... again.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.psycholog: Your hamster exudes an aura of pure, unadulterated menace that is apparently only perceptible to giant <b>Spiders</> and angry horned <b>Ravagers</>.$(br2)Use this knowledge to your advantage— watch as the Ravager desperately flees from something that is
$(br)small enough to accidentally be snorted up its nostril.$(br2)Wait... perhaps that's what the Ravager is so afraid of?$(br2)This needs further investigation.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.aggressio: Sometimes your furry friend is a little <i>too</> enthusiastic about defending you. Or maybe not enthusiastic enough.$(br2)Good news: their tiny brains are easily reprogrammable via their stomachs. You can permanently alter their aggression level$(br)   with food.

$(br)<b>Pacifist:</> Feed them any type of flower ($(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>configurable</>). They become hippies, blankly staring while you get mauled.$(br)<b>Neutral:</> Feed them <gold><b>{NEUTRAL_ITEM}</> for a factory reset.$(br)<b>Menace:</> Feed them <gold><b>{MENACE_ITEM}</> to unleash their inner rodent. They'll hunt monsters and anything you $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>configure</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.crops_: You can't build a hamster empire on an empty stomach.$(br2)This chapter covers the entire food chain, from foraging for wild seeds to cultivating $(l:crops_food/green_beans)<dark_green><b>performance-enhancing legumes</>.$(br2)Also, $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>Cheese</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.sunflower: These aren't your average, purely decorative sunflowers. Right-click a seeded one to harvest <dark_green><b>Sunflower Seeds</>— a key ingredient for the $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>Hamster Food Mix</>.$(br2)Use <b>Bone Meal</> or plant the seeds to create more.
Find these <dark_green><b>Wild Cucumber Bushes</> lurking in warmer biomes.$(br2)Right-click a seeded one.$(br2)This is the first step on your path to hamster-fueled glory.
Plant the seeds.$(br2)Wait. Wait some more.$(br2)Harvest the <dark_green><b>Cucumber</>. Try not to starve while waiting.$(br2)You'll also get more seeds back, because that's how farming works.

Craft a cucumber to get the coveted <dark_green><b>Sliced Cucumber</>.$(br2)This is the primary currency for $(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<b>taming</> a wild hamster and can also be used for $(l:the_hamster_life/feeding)<b>healing</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.green_bea: Find these <dark_green><b>Wild Green Bean Bushes</> in temperate or wet areas. Right-click to procure seeds.$(br2)These aren't your garden-variety legumes.
Plant the seeds, wait for the magic to happen, then harvest your <dark_green><b>Green Beans</>.$(br2)Simple.

Smelt Green Beans in a furnace to create <dark_green><b>Steamed Green Beans</>.$(br2)These can be used for $(l:the_hamster_life/feeding)<dark_green><b>healing</>, and— much more importantly— for commencing the awe-inspiring $(l:the_hamster_life/feeding#buffs)<dark_green><b>Hamster Zoomies</>.
Yes, you smelt it. Makes perfect sense.$(br2)A more... intuitive steaming method is planned for a future update, maybe involving a multi-block structure... and water buckets? We shall see.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hamster_f: Craft this. Or don't. Your hamster, your problem.$(br2)But anyway, it heals well and crucially, is one of the few items they'll never refuse, even if fed repeatedly. It's also the key to convincing them that their face is a perfectly viable $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<b>storage solution</>.
$(br)Failure to follow these instructions precisely may result in the accidental creation of a new form of sentient gravel.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.cheese.pa: Not only is this delicacy ideal for tempting small rodents onto your person, you also eat it.$(br2)It's suspiciously nourishing and slips right down the old gullet more quickly than other foods, if you can stomach the... <i>moist sounds</>.
Yes, this is the alchemical process of transmuting a bucket of milk directly into three solid wedges of cheese. It's science. Don't question it.$(br2)(Turn page)
$(br)A more involved, thematically appropriate cheese-making process is planned for a future update.$(br2)$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/join_the_discord)<b>Join the Discord</> to help shape the future!
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.loot_a: If it isn't nailed down, it's yours.$(br2)If it <i>is</> nailed down, bring a crowbar.$(br2)This section details where to find hamster-related loot, whether in a chest or inside a rodent's face.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.world_loo: Hamster-related loot can be found contaminating various places. You can find basic items like $(l:crops_food)<dark_green><b>Seeds</>, common $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>Armor</> types, (acorn, iron, gold) rotting away in:$(br2)• Villages/Outposts$(br)• Mineshafts/Dungeons$(br)• Shipwrecks/Ruins$(br)• Pyramids/Temples$(br)• Ruined Portals

$(br)Looking for $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#diamond_perk)<dark_green><b>Diamond Armor</> or smithing $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#upgrades)<dark_green><b>Templates</>? Stop digging and start raiding. They prefer danger:$(br2)• Fortresses/Bastions$(br)• End Cities$(br)• Strongholds$(br)• Trial Chambers$(br2)If you enabled $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#perks)<dark_green><b>Netherite Armor</> loot in the config, it spawns there too.

$(br)Legendary items like $(l:accessories)<dark_green><b>Accessories</> and advanced smithing $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#upgrades)<dark_green><b>Templates</> are hoarded in the annoying locations:$(br2)• Ancient Cities$(br)• Woodland Mansions$(br)• Stronghold Libraries$(br)• Buried Treasure$(br)• Ominous Spawners$(br2)Bring a weapon. Or sacrifice a friend.

$(br)Don't like the drop rates? Think Hamster Armor is too rare or too common?$(br2)Check the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</>.$(br2)You can tweak the spawn chance for every category of loot, enable Netherite Armor drops, or disable world loot entirely if you hate fun.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hamster_l: Wild hamsters are nature's vacuum cleaners. About 50%% of them spawn with their cheek pouches containing whatever floor debris they could fit inside.$(br2)Expect to find $(l:crops_food)<dark_green><b>Seeds</>, nuggets, veggies, and other small trinkets. They're shy, so bring$(br)   $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<dark_green><b>bribes</>.

$(br)Don't like their hoarding habits? Think they should be scavenging for Nether Stars instead of Wheat Seeds?$(br2)I anticipated your need for control. You can configure exactly what items they spawn with and the rarity of those items in the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.the_ki: You stepped into the right dimension, my friend.$(br2)Here you'll find the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>config</>, $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands)<dark_green><b>admin commands</>, our bustling online $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/join_the_discord)<dark_green><b>hamster fan club</>, and a <i>conveniently</> placed $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/support_the_mod)<dark_green><b>donation box</>.$(br2)Rummage around.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.missing_b: Misplaced this invaluable tome of rodent wisdom, or need another one?$(br2)Shocking.$(br2)Use $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands#give_guidebook)<b>/ahp give_guidebook</>, or craft another with a vanilla <b>Book</> and some $(l:crops_food/cucumber#item)<dark_green><b>Sliced Cucumber</>.
Don't ask why Sliced Cucumber.$(br2)It's a long story involving a very particular hamster and an unfortunate water polo incident.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.config_he: Not a fan of earning your hamster's trust for cheek storage? Wish those tooltips would just vanish? Good news for the micromanagers: this mod is highly configurable. Tweak to your heart's content.$(br2)Or break everything. Your call.
$(br)For convenience, I coded a custom button so you can access the full configuration screen directly from this book.$(br2)No idea what a config is? Prepare for awesomeness.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.join_the_: Got a genius idea for the next hamster accessory? Want to share screenshots of your furry army? Or maybe you just want to see what's coming next?$(br2)Pop over to the official Discord server:$(br)<gold><b><i>The Cheek Pouch.</>
$(br)I've got channels for suggestions, bug reports, screenshots, and even a showcase for your real-life pets.$(br2)Come help shape the future of the mod!
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.ahp_comma: For those who wish to bypass nature entirely.$(br2)Use <b>/ahp spawn hamster</> to generate any specific variant.$(br2)Comes with auto-complete suggestions so you don't have to remember {TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS} genomes.

These next two commands allow you to see hamster types, organized in groups.$(br2)By default, they spawn just the {BASE_PALETTES} base colors. You can append true/false arguments to stack on layers of genetic complexity, or filter textures by author name.

But before that, you need to know about <dark_green><b>Performance Mode</>.$(br2)This strips away all textures and geometry, turning the hamsters into highly-efficient grayscale cubes. Toggle it with a custom keybind in your <b>Controls</> settings.

Systematically organizes hamsters into a flat 2D grid based on their mathematically-determined, 3D color zones for easy access in case you want to $(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>Tame</> them.$(br2)$(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>Taming</> them will 'wake them up,' re-enabling their AI.

Spawns hamsters in the air. Their physical x,y,z coordinates represent Hue, Saturation and Brightness in 3D space.$(br2)It's a cylindrical, rodent color wheel used to understand the breeding math and estimate offspring$(br)   colors.

Set <b>wild overlays</> to <b>true</> to see all {TOTAL_WILD_VARIANTS} wild variants.$(br2)Set <b>sample breeding overlays</> to <b>true</> to see them crossed with a tiny sample of 3 breeding overlays, resulting in {TOTAL_WILD_PLUS_BREEDING_SAMPLE_VARIANTS} variants.

Set <b>match player yaw</> to face them all in the same direction for the perfect group photo.$(br2)Set <b>randomize sitting</> and/or <b>sleeping</> to 'TRUE' if you want to add some variation to the display.

While holding this guidebook, right-click two hamsters in the 3D layout to project a particle cloud of their potential offspring.$(br2)Admins can use arrow keys to adjust genetic variance & mutation rate. Changes are saved to the config immediately & apply$(br)   server-wide.

Spawns a random assortment of genetically distinct hamsters. You must provide a number for the <count> argument, or to spawn EVERY possible combination, use 'all_THIS_CAN_BREAK_YOUR_WORLD' as the count.$(br2)Warning: this will spawn {TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS} hamsters, and can <red><b>permanently ruin</> your world.
Made a mistake and spawned a 5,000-hamster grid in your living room?$(br2)This command instantly vaporizes all hamsters generated by your very last spawn command.

Force the genetics engine to recalculate and print its current 3D color-space and overlay exclusion math to the <b>log</> or <b>chat</>.$(br2)Useful to see what effect your $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>config</> changes are having on the total possible variant numbers without needing to$(br)   spawn them.

Time travel. Set a hamster's age in days, months, or years. Comes with auto-complete suggestions.$(br2)Useful if you just updated to v3.6.0 and your old hamster friend is now <i>zero days old</>. Targets the nearest hamster if you don't look at one.

<b>/reset_player</>$(br2)Wipes your breeding record clean.$(br2)Useful if breeding limits are enabled for your server and you've hit your $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>configured</> lifetime quota.

<b>/reset_hamster</>$(br2)Hamsters have a $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>configurable</> limit on how many litters they can produce.$(br2)This resets the nearest hamster's quota to zero, allowing them back into the dating pool.

Neuralyzes the local ecosystem.$(br2)All trees instantly forget you $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#intro)<dark_green><b>raided them</> and return to full profitability.$(br2)Nature is so forgiving.
